title: Are Pinnacle’s Occupational Therapists specialised in working with children with autism?
metaTitle: Specialized Occupational Therapists for Children with Autism - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover how Pinnacle Blooms Network's Occupational Therapists are specially trained to work with children with autism. Learn about their expertise in addressing the unique challenges of autism.
html: Yes, our Occupational Therapists have specific training and experience in working with children with autism. They are skilled at addressing the unique challenges and strengths of each child on the spectrum.
